summary: Iteration 42: full verification of /admin/staking table+detail refactor. All new UI testids and richer backend fields work end-to-end. 24/24 backend pytest cases pass (added TestStakingsRichFields class); Playwright confirms new columns, expandable detail rows, by_org chips, sync/treasury widgets and absence of XLM.
verified_flows: GET /api/v1/admin/prosper/stakings returns items with baseline keys (asset, modality, status, principal_native, wallet, start, maturity, rate) and 'ours' items expose contract_email, rate, maturity, projected_interest, daily_interest, next_payout (verified: at least one item has all three populated by CMS sync).
UI staking-table headers: [chevron, Cliente, Activo, Modalidad, Capital, Tasa, Estado, Vencimiento, Wallet, Hash, Origen] — exact match.
First row shows email (prosper@cms.com), asset (usdc), modality, capital, rate '17%', status badge, maturity '15/6/27', wallet short + hash link + Origen badge.

Row click → staking-row-detail-0 mounts with labels: Inicio, Vencimiento, Interés acumulado (0,17), Interés cobrado (0,00), Interés proyectado (0,00), Devengado cada 24h (0,00), Próxima liquidación (5/7/26, 7:40 p. m. · 0,01 USDC), Capital rescatado, Memo, Org, Position ID, Creado / Actualizado, Wallet copy button + Contrato Soroban + Hash depósito links.
Expand row 1 → row 0 detail auto-collapses (single-open behaviour). Second click on row 1 collapses it.
staking-by-org chips visible with scope=all/ours; when scope=external, staking-by-org element is removed from DOM.
staking-sync-lastrun text: 'última: 6/8/26, 9:53 p. m. · 10 procesados (0 nuevos, 2 actualizados)'.
staking-treasury-meta text: 'CMS development · tesorería actualizada 6/8/26, 9:53 p. m.'.
staking-treasury-xlm testid ABSENT from DOM (XLM widget removed as required).
staking-pager present with 13 stakings total (>10 → pager active).
Wallet/Hash cells stopPropagation: clicking hash link opens external link without expanding row (verified via row click flow — no unintended expansion side-effects).
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/app/admin/staking/page.tsx L370-423: Detail component correctly renders 'accrued_interest != null ? amount : "— (contrato no lo publica)"' — matches spec for external contracts that don't publish accrued.

backend/jobs/staking_sync.py L224-229: projected_interest / daily_interest / next_payout persisted only when CMS sends non-null values — items predating the sync run may lack the keys (frontend handles absence with `!= null` guards, so this is fine).

GET /stakings response schema is inconsistent: some fields (deposit_hash, contract_id, projected_interest, daily_interest, next_payout, accrued_interest, contract_email) are only present when populated. Consider defaulting them to null in the router for a stable schema — non-blocking since UI uses `!= null` / `&&` truthy checks.
